description: This Java class implements a service engine that invokes static Java methods based on service definitions, handling reflection and exceptions.

classes.name: StandardJavaEngine
classes.description: A final class that extends GenericAsyncEngine, responsible for executing Java static method services.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides runSyncIgnore to call runSync, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes the service synchronously and returns the result map, throwing exception if result is invalid.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Uses reflection to invoke a static or instance method specified by the service's location and invoke attributes.
